compiled_state.title: Close deliberate-violation PR, delete test branch, record CLOSED state
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: Deliberate-violation PR closed without merging and branch deleted; gh pr view --state all shows CLOSED; output recorded as ticket comment

## Description

Read the PR number and branch name from the ticket comment left by Task 4159-2831-f637-4c9d (VIOLATION_PR comment), close the PR without merging, delete the test branch, and verify the final state.

### Steps

1. Read PR info from ticket comment:
```bash
VIOLATION_COMMENT=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show 733f-938c-e6d9-464d | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
for c in d.get('comments',[]):
    if 'VIOLATION_PR:' in c.get('body','') and 'VIOLATION_PR_CHECKS:' not in c.get('body',''):
        print(c['body'])
        break
")
PR_NUMBER=$(echo "$VIOLATION_COMMENT" | grep -oE 'pr=[0-9]+' | cut -d= -f2)
BRANCH_NAME=$(echo "$VIOLATION_COMMENT" | grep -oE 'branch=[^ ]+' | cut -d= -f2)
echo "PR: $PR_NUMBER, Branch: $BRANCH_NAME"
```

2. Close the PR without merging:
```bash
CLOSE_OUTPUT=$(gh pr close "$PR_NUMBER" --repo navapbc/digital-service-orchestra \
  --comment "Closing as planned — CI enforcement validation complete. This PR was a deliberate-violation test for epic 1083-fb3d story 733f-938c." 2>&1)
echo "Close output: $CLOSE_OUTPUT"
```

3. Delete the test branch:
```bash
DELETE_OUTPUT=$(git push origin --delete "$BRANCH_NAME" 2>&1 || \
  gh api -X DELETE "repos/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/git/refs/heads/$BRANCH_NAME" 2>&1 || true)
echo "Delete output: $DELETE_OUTPUT"
```

4. Verify the PR is CLOSED:
```bash
VIEW_OUTPUT=$(gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --repo navapbc/digital-service-orchestra \
  --json state,title,number,headRefName 2>&1)
echo "$VIEW_OUTPUT"
```

5. Record evidence as ticket comment:
```bash
.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment 733f-938c-e6d9-464d "VIOLATION_PR_CLOSED: pr=$PR_NUMBER branch=$BRANCH_NAME state=$(echo "$VIEW_OUTPUT" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"state\",\"unknown\"))' 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown') output=$VIEW_OUTPUT"
```

6. Also clean up the violation file from the local filesystem if it was checked out:
```bash
rm -f tests/scripts/test-ci-violation-733f.sh 2>/dev/null || true
```

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5 || true
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] VIOLATION_PR_CLOSED comment recorded on ticket 733f-938c
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show 733f-938c-e6d9-464d | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); found=[c for c in d.get('comments',[]) if 'VIOLATION_PR_CLOSED:' in c.get('body','')]; exit(0 if found else 1)"
- [ ] PR state is CLOSED
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show 733f-938c-e6d9-464d | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); comments=[c for c in d.get('comments',[]) if 'VIOLATION_PR_CLOSED:' in c.get('body','')]; body=comments[-1]['body'] if comments else ''; exit(0 if 'state=CLOSED' in body or '\"state\":\"CLOSED\"' in body else 1)"
